note: Accessibility rows of sandbox spec §8, in docs/csharp/sindri-ui.md's terms. SB-6's done-when includes a test for each row.

rows.screenReader: name "Sandbox: on, writes only to <folder>" ("Sandbox: on, attended, writes only to <folder>" for a session you open); headroom as text "memory 2.1 of 12 GiB"

rows.keyboard: a focus-region group (ControlTypeOverride=Group) with a named peer; its fix text before its buttons
rows.screenReader: name "Needs you: Step <x> can't start, <first clause of the golden sentence>", never the raw reason code
rows.focus: when it appears from a user action, focus goes to its heading; when it is answered and goes, focus moves to its neighbour (the Health row or Park section heading it came from; the KeepFocus case) after the live region has spoken "Ready. Resuming <n> Steps"
rows.textScaleAndColour: wraps; severity as a word and an icon

rows.keyboard: Enter and Space; the 2 px focus ring
rows.screenReader: a zero-width transparent TextBlock with LiveSetting=Polite already in the tree before its state; its Text changes (never set to ""); "Sending…" after 300 ms, then the result
rows.focus: stays on the button (enabled for the keyboard) while checking; a second click does nothing; the region rests on the label before a repeat outcome, so a repeated "still failing" is a change

rows.screenReader: the list read before the buttons
rows.focus: on Not now, back to Check again

rows.keyboard: a list; each row's fix button is reachable
rows.screenReader: each row reads by kind (host, path, permanent path, tool) as in states.json blockedList
rows.focus: the Allow button keeps focus through Sending and "Needs your approval"

rows.keyboard: in the run's row, not a trap
rows.screenReader: a polite zero-width live TextBlock, present before its state: "Waiting for a free session slot, <n> of <cap> running" once, then "Started" when it starts by itself
the same polite live TextBlock: "Sending", then "Needs your approval: open the approval to allow <target>", then "Allowed" or "Refused"
rows.focus: stays on the Allow button through every state

rows.keyboard: not a trap; dismissible once, back after reattach
rows.screenReader: a polite zero-width live TextBlock, read once on appearance
row name "Sandbox: <state>"; learn mode "learning, ends in <days> days"
